summary:
Frontend-only validation of the RESTRUCTURED Cisco-stack Device Trajectory (/xdr/edr/device-trajectory?device=dev_42e8c6dc74b9) after: (a) navigator moved to full-width row, (b) computer strip collapsed by default + filter strip beside it, (c) right-hand list replaced by Event Details panel (amp-details-panel/close/empty + amp-details-timestamp/disposition/type/description, amp-mitre-box, amp-observables + amp-observable-N + amp-observable-expand-N, amp-observed-activity, amp-detected-by, amp-d-piid/ppiid/parent-row/parent-state/display-label/content-digest, amp-details-pivot-*), (d) 5 restored Navigator control testids (zoom-in/out, step-back/fwd, fit-day) plus presets 1d/7d/14d/30d/all inside the Filters menu and amp-navigator-collapse, (e) ROW_H=15, (f) sensor display label NO LONGER rendered as detection, (g) connector/lane data-* attributes exposed.

EVIDENCE:
- All 20+ required testids present at first paint (dt-heading, amp-legacy-link, amp-fullscreen-toggle, amp-computer-header, amp-filter-bar, amp-filters-button, amp-filter-search, amp-filter-count, amp-navigator, amp-nav-sparkline, amp-nav-day-band, amp-nav-hour-band, amp-nav-window, amp-workspace, amp-vscroll, amp-hscroll, amp-details-panel, amp-details-empty, amp-status). amp-details-close only appears with a selected event (correct — spec).
- REGRESSION-CRITICAL FIX CONFIRMED: clicked an ordinary process_create event → amp-details-detected-line COUNT = 0, amp-d-display-label shows 'sleep · process create' (sensor label), amp-details-type = 'Process created'. Then applied amp-filter-type-detection → count = '4 / 6356 observations', 4 amp-compromise-marker-* + 4 amp-compromise-band-*, 12 amp-lane-* rendered; clicking a detection → amp-details-detected-line COUNT = 1 AND amp-details-detection-flag COUNT = 1.
- LINEAGE: 33 amp-connector-* rendered on default view, connector 0 data-parent-lane-index=4 data-child-lane-index=5 (bash→timeout, matches API pre-order). Parent states in DOM across first 30 lanes: OBSERVED=10, PARENT_NOT_REPORTED_BY_SENSOR=2, PARENT_NOT_OBSERVED_VISIBILITY_GAP=3 — all three trichotomy states VISIBLE as data-parent-state on amp-lane-* nodes; data-lane-group, data-parent-lane-index, data-end-state also present.
- DEEP ROWS (ROW_H=15): scrolled amp-vscroll.scrollTop to 100*15/300*15/430*15. At row 100: 38 events, 76 lifelines, 38 connectors. Row 300: 38/76/38. Row 430: 108 events, 54 lifelines, 0 connectors (tail — parents fall outside), plus amp-section-'Files & Network' label appears exactly at the file/network band.
- NAVIGATOR: amp-nav-day-2026-09-06 click → 'window 24.0 h · 2026-09-06 00:00:00 → 2026-09-07 00:00:00 UTC'. amp-nav-zoom-in → 12.0 h. amp-nav-fit-day → back to 24 h. amp-nav-step-back/fwd, amp-nav-zoom-out all update the window. Presets 1d/7d/14d/30d/all all present inside Filters menu; preset 7d → 'window 7.0 d · 2026-08-30 → 2026-09-06'. amp-navigator-collapse hides amp-nav-sparkline correctly.
- FILTERS: detection filter reduces to 4/6356 with axis reduced to 4 rows + compromise bands/markers. Zero-hit search 'zzz_no_such_indicator_zzz' → amp-canvas-empty rendered and count='0 / 6356 observations' (honest empty state, not a silent blank).
- SELECTION + DEEP LINK: selecting an event sets ?event=<iid> in URL. Loading /xdr/edr/device-trajectory?device=dev_42e8c6dc74b9&event=evt_35f0367442be7e55%23d3d459a923 directly re-selects it after first paint (amp-details-timestamp + amp-d-piid populated, no amp-locate-deeplink needed — event was in loaded window). Selected row highlighted in gutter.
- FULLSCREEN: amp-fullscreen-toggle → amp-fullscreen overlay active, preserves endpoint + selection + window; toggling back removes overlay.
- REGRESSION: /edr/trajectory 200, /edr 200, /edr/detections 200, /edr/process-tree 200, /edr/campaign-story 200. No console errors on the trajectory page.
- ALIGNMENT AUDIT (pixel measurements):
  * 1920x1080: workspace right=1891, details right=1890, vscroll.right=1542=details.left, hscroll.right=1542=details.left, hscroll.bottom=1027=details.bottom=1027, workspace.bottom=1028. Perfectly flush.
  * 1600x900: workspace right=1571, details right=1570, vscroll.right=1222=details.left, hscroll.right=1222=details.left, hscroll.bottom=852=details.bottom=852. Flush.
  * 1440x900: workspace right=1411, details right=1410, vscroll.right=1062=details.left, hscroll.right=1062=details.left, hscroll.bottom=847=details.bottom=847. Flush.
  No overflow, no dead space, no mismatched heights at any of the three viewport sizes.
critical_code_review_comments: REGRESSION-CRITICAL WIN: an ordinary process_create no longer displays the sensor's display_label as a detection. amp-details-detected-line is correctly ABSENT for UNKNOWN_NOT_ASSESSED / non-rule events and correctly PRESENT (in red) with amp-details-detection-flag on a real detection — exactly the Cisco semantic.

Lineage trichotomy is now DOM-observable without needing an event row: every amp-lane-* group exposes data-parent-state (OBSERVED / PARENT_NOT_REPORTED_BY_SENSOR / PARENT_NOT_OBSERVED_VISIBILITY_GAP), data-parent-lane-index, data-lane-group, data-end-state; and every amp-connector-* exposes data-parent-lane-index + data-child-lane-index + data-parent-in-view. This resolves the iteration-97 blocker where VISIBILITY_GAP was untestable via the events list.

Cisco-stack composition is pixel-clean at 1920x1080, 1600x900 and 1440x900: right-hand Event Details panel is flush against the vertical scrollbar and shares its bottom with the horizontal scrollbar; the workspace has no dead space and no clipped/overflowing element at any of the three viewport sizes.

5 restored Navigator control testids (amp-nav-zoom-in/out, amp-nav-step-back/fwd, amp-nav-fit-day) all update amp-nav-window correctly (24h→12h on zoom-in, 24h on fit-day, 7d on preset-7d). Wheel-zoom is intentionally off (wheel scrolls the activity axis) — correct per spec.

Deep-scroll (rows 100, 300, 430 with ROW_H=15) still renders real amp-event-*, amp-lifeline-* and amp-connector-* nodes with no empty rows; amp-section-'Files & Network' surfaces exactly when the axis crosses into file/network lanes.

success_rate.frontend: ~100% — all 10 requested behaviours pass (structural restructure, Event Details panel, sensor-label-not-detection regression, lineage data attributes, deep rows, navigator, filters, selection + deep link, fullscreen, legacy regression) and alignment is pixel-flush at 1920x1080, 1600x900, 1440x900

context_for_next_testing_agent: The Cisco-stack restructure is complete and clean. Key selectors and expected behaviours: (1) amp-details-close only exists when an event is selected — it is correctly absent in the empty state. (2) Presets amp-preset-1d/7d/14d/30d/all live INSIDE the Filters menu (open with amp-filters-button first). (3) Navigator control testids amp-nav-zoom-in/out, amp-nav-step-back/fwd, amp-nav-fit-day are all present and update amp-nav-window text. (4) Every amp-lane-* exposes data-parent-state / data-parent-lane-index / data-lane-group / data-end-state; every amp-connector-* exposes data-parent-lane-index / data-child-lane-index / data-parent-in-view — assert lineage via these, not via the (removed) events list. (5) ROW_H=15px. (6) The sensor's display label surfaces via amp-d-display-label ('Sensor label · <label>'), NOT via amp-details-detected-line. (7) Deep rows 100/300/430 all render real content; the 'Files & Network' section label appears once at the file/network band. First paint takes ~14s; the deep-link URL parameter (?event=<iid>) re-selects on reload once the window loads.
rca of the issue: No issue to root-cause this iteration — every regression the review request flagged as CRITICAL (sensor-label-shown-as-detection, missing Navigator control testids, VISIBILITY_GAP lineage state untestable, alignment at three viewport sizes) is fixed and DOM-verifiable. The removed amp-events-panel + amp-events-row-* selectors are correctly gone and replaced by the Cisco-exact amp-details-* Event Details panel.
